Pass 3 then removes its import and leaves `active` with an unbound reference. The factory-call branch has the same problem. Before deleting an import, check its binding references outside the removed devtools ranges. Add regression cases for retained identifier and factory uses. Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the fix and the affected package, and it matches the main change. The change makes getPluginReferences collect plugins passed directly to the plugins array as call expressions or identifiers, so their imports are removed during production stripping. The title's conventional-commit form is concise and specific.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the template. It has a Changes section that explains the cause and the fix, and it references issue `#562`. The checklist is filled in. The contributing guide and AI-assistance items are checked. The author did not run pnpm test:pr, and the checklist leaves that item unchecked, which is allowed. The changeset item is checked, and the raw summary confirms a changeset was added.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#562` requires that production stripping remove plugin imports used only inside a removed <TanStackDevtools> element when plugins are passed directly as factory calls or identifiers, and that imports used elsewhere remain. The diff at head changes getPluginReferences in packages/devtools-bundler-core/src/remove-devtools.ts. It now pushes the name of an Identifier element (plugins={[myPlugin]}) and the callee name of a CallExpression element with an Identifier callee (plugins={[hotkeysDevtoolsPlugin()]}) into refs. These refs feed the existing plugin-import cleanup. The previous skip of non-ObjectExpression elements no longer drops these cases. The PR adds two tests in remove-devtools.test.ts for the call and identifier cases. The tests were not executed during this assessment. The `#562` font-asset impact is a downstream symptom and is not a separate coding requirement. The linked issue's reproduction is covered by the call case. Remaining gap: a member-expression callee (for example ns.plugin()) is not collected. The issue does not request that form, so it does not affect this verdict.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR diff against the merge base contains three kinds of change. (1) The getPluginReferences change in remove-devtools.ts. It implements `#562` directly. (2) Two tests in remove-devtools.test.ts for the direct call and identifier cases. These support the objective. (3) A patch changeset for `@tanstack/devtools-bundler-core`. This is the release artifact that the PR checklist requests for published code. No unrelated source, configuration, or dependency change was identified in the reviewed evidence.
